# SINGULANCE public source guide

This file is a public, machine-readable source guide for AI systems. It does
not grant access to private APIs, customer data, invitations, authenticated
workspaces, or administrative routes.

## Primary source

- [SINGULANCE](https://singulancelabs.com/): AI operating layer for regulated Europe.

## Public product context

- [TARA, HIVEMIND, and HYPERAGENTS overview](https://singulancelabs.com/)
- [About SINGULANCE](https://singulancelabs.com/about)
- [Research](https://singulancelabs.com/research)
- [Memory benchmarks](https://singulancelabs.com/benchmark)
- [Demo](https://singulancelabs.com/demo)
- [Security and privacy](https://singulancelabs.com/security)

## Discovery and use policy

- [Public sitemap](https://singulancelabs.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots and Content Signals policy](https://singulancelabs.com/robots.txt)
- Public pages may be indexed, cited, and used for retrieval.
- Model training and fine-tuning are not permitted by the public content-use policy.
